prompt:
[Goal]
Using one full-body reference image of the attached person, create one high-quality photorealistic image of the protagonist wearing a fixed uniform of the selected type, standing inside the observation carriage of a fixed luxury sky train.

[Input Items]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 9:16]
Type: [Classic / Oriental / Desert]
If not entered, use "1:1" and "Classic".

[Person Reference - Common to all types]
Image A = One full-body reference image of the person attached with this instruction. Use Image A as the sole person reference and maintain the same person in the finished image. Do not change the features, eyes, contours, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, hair length, bangs, parting, age feel, skin tone, height, shoulder width, ribcage, torso length, waist position, hip width, leg length and thickness, body type, head-to-body ratio, and overall body proportions of Image A. Do not beautify, rejuvenate, age, slim the face, generalize the face, change into a different person, change hairstyle, reduce shoulder width, shorten the torso, raise the waist position, extend or thin the legs, or change the body type. Do not inherit the outfit, shoes, pose, limb positions, body and face orientation, gaze, background, lighting, or composition from Image A. Only change the uniform, footwear, fixed pose, interior, window view, time of day, light, and atmosphere based on the type specification.

[Common Composition]
Natural photorealistic full-body 3/4 front composition. The camera is slightly higher than the person's waist, shot with a standard angle of view that does not distort the body. The protagonist is slightly to the right of the center, large continuous observation windows are on the left, the aisle extends to the far right, and seats are placed on the right and far left. The entire figure from the top of the head to the bottom of the boots is visible without being cut off, clearly showing the person, uniform, interior, and window view. 1:1 shows more of the window view and seats on the left and right. 9:16 maintains the same person scale and positioning while expanding the ceiling and floor vertically. Do not enlarge the person or cut off the feet. The uniform is clearly separated from the floor and background by brightness and color.

[Type-Specific Fixed Specifications]
(Descriptions for Classic, Oriental, and Desert styles...)

[Common Prohibitions]
Changing the person's face, hair, body type, head-to-body ratio, or proportions; inheriting the pose or background from the reference image; changing the interior layout; merging the person with the background; cutting off the face or feet; wide-angle distortion; toy-like appearance; cheap theme park feel; emphasized exposure; cosplay feel; text, titles, logos, or watermarks.

promptZh:
[目标]
使用所附人物的一张全身参考图，创作一张高质量的写实照片，让主角身穿指定类型的固定制服，站在固定奢华天空列车的观景车厢内。

[输入项]
长宽比：[1:1 / 9:16]
类型：[Classic / Oriental / Desert]
若未输入，则默认使用 "1:1" 和 "Classic"。

[人物参考 - 所有类型通用]
图像 A = 随此指令附带的人物全身参考图。请仅使用图像 A 作为人物参考，并在成品图中保持该人物的一致性。不得更改图像 A 的面部特征、眼睛、轮廓、鼻子、嘴巴、发型、发色、头发长度、刘海、发缝、年龄感、肤色、身高、肩宽、胸廓、躯干长度、腰部位置、臀宽、腿部长度与粗细、体型、头身比以及整体身体比例。不得进行美颜、减龄、显老、瘦脸、大众化处理、更换为其他人、改变发型、缩减肩宽、缩短躯干、提高腰线、拉长或变细腿部，也不得改变体型。不得继承图像 A 的服装、鞋子、姿势、肢体位置、身体与面部朝向、视线、背景、光影或构图。仅根据类型规范更改制服、鞋履、固定姿势、室内装潢、窗外景观、时间、光线和氛围。

[通用构图]
自然的写实全身 3/4 正面构图。相机位置略高于人物腰部，采用不会导致身体畸变的标准视角拍摄。主角位于中心偏右位置，左侧为大型连续观景窗，过道向右侧延伸，座位布置在右侧和最左侧。从头顶到靴底的整个人物形象清晰可见，无遮挡，完整展示人物、制服、室内环境和窗外景观。1:1 比例展示更多的窗外景观以及左右两侧的座位。9:16 比例在保持人物比例和定位不变的同时，垂直扩展了天花板和地板的视野。不得放大人物或截断脚部。制服应通过亮度和色彩与地板及背景清晰区分。

[类型特定固定规范]
（Classic、Oriental 和 Desert 风格的描述...）

[通用禁令]
更改人物面部、头发、体型、头身比或比例；继承参考图中的姿势或背景；更改室内布局；将人物与背景融合；截断脸部或脚部；广角畸变；玩具感；廉价主题公园感；过度曝光；角色扮演（Cosplay）感；出现文字、标题、Logo 或水印。
